description: This file defines a PHP class 'Report' within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for handling the display of the report list in the admin interface. It loads necessary language files, gathers installed report modules, checks permissions, and prepares data for rendering the report view.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class for handling report listing in admin interface, extending base Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to prepare and render the report list page, including loading language, gathering report modules, sorting, and rendering views.
